title: Public Sector Data Quality Commons
description: Check data against quality rules, draft rules, assess against framework packs, translate results between frameworks and score issues with the UK government issues framework.

safety.personal_data: results contain examples of failing rows; keep the root folder free of data the agent should not see
safety.human_in_loop: rules drafted by an agent must be reviewed before use

tools.name: check_data
tools.title: Check data against rules
tools.description: Run a rules file on a dataset. Returns rules met, issues with GOV.UK issues framework priorities, a suggested trust level and the DQAP route.

tools.name: suggest_rules
tools.title: Suggest starter rules
tools.description: Profile a dataset and draft a starter rules file (YAML). A data steward must review every rule.

tools.name: validate_rules
tools.title: Validate a rules file
tools.description: Check a rules file (YAML) is well formed: known checks, identifier schemes, value sets, unique ids.

tools.name: assess_pack
tools.title: Assess against a framework pack
tools.description: Check data and rules, then report which requirements of a framework or scenario pack are met (for example uk-dam-cda, uk-gdqf, ai-ml-readiness, iso-iec-25012).

tools.name: crosswalk
tools.title: Translate results into another framework
tools.description: Check data and rules, then restate the dimension scores in another framework's terms (for example iso-iec-25012, ess-qaf, canada-gc-dq).

tools.name: score_issue
tools.title: Score an issue with the issues framework
tools.description: Given importance (1-4), impact (1-4) and measured performance (%), return the target, band, priority and resolution timescale from the GOV.UK data quality issues framework.

tools.name: list_frameworks
tools.title: List frameworks and standards
tools.description: The registry of data quality frameworks, standards and policies (UK, devolved, sector and international), optionally filtered by text.

tools.name: list_packs
tools.title: List framework packs
tools.description: The packs that apply frameworks to results.

tools.name: explore_knowledge
tools.title: Explore the data quality knowledge graph
tools.description: Search the Commons knowledge graph (glossary, thesaurus, frameworks, packs, checks, dimensions, issue types, metadata standards, roles, skills, courses, events and jurisdictions). Give 'query' to find concepts, 'node' to list its relationships, or 'from' and 'to' to trace the shortest chain of relationships between two concepts.

tools.name: weave_metadata
tools.title: Weave a metadata record into every catalogue standard
tools.description: Read one dataset record (DCAT or schema.org JSON-LD, a CKAN package or an ODCS contract) and return it as DCAT v3, schema.org, CKAN and an ODCS skeleton, with the gaps for each and the 13 CDA metadata properties.

tools.name: check_contract
tools.title: Check an ODCS data contract
tools.description: Validate an ODCS v3 contract; with 'previous', list the changes, which ones break consumers, and the version to use.

tools.name: list_checks
tools.title: List checks, identifier schemes and value sets
tools.description: What the rules language supports: check types, identifier schemes and value sets.
